{{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} |contains = 10 }} {{QuoteContainer|{{QuoteBox|A high-grade consumable crate, HANDLE WITH CAUTION!|In-Game Description}}}} ==Description== The '''High Grade Crate''' is a high-tier consumable crate in the game, purchasable for {{Robux|50}}. It yields ten consumables, with {{Color|Rare}} rarity consumables being most common. This crate gives eight consumables when unlocked. As there is no limit on how many consumables you can have, it is possible to get duplicates of them from this crate. ==Methods of Obtaining== #Purchase in the store for {{Robux|50}}. #Chance to appear as the reward for [[Quests#Damage Dealer|Damage Dealer]] weekly quests with a 4,000,000 damage requirement. #*This quest can appear multiple times. #Purchase [[VIP+]] #*Six '''High Grade Crates''' are given for both the first time purchase and every subsequent renewal. #Beating Challenge Maps. #*Beating [[Jailed Towers (Challenge)|Jailed Towers]] or [[Legion (Challenge)|Legion]] will give 2 '''High Grade Crates.''' #*Beating [[Back to Basics (Challenge)|Back to Basics]] will give 3 '''High Grade Crates.''' #Day 27 of the [[Login Rewards]], track A and B. #1.07% chance of getting one and 0.14% chance of getting four from the [[Spin Wheel]]. #Triumphing a match. #*[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode: 5% chance. #*[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode: 2.5% chance. #*[[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode: 5% chance. #Completing the ''Keeper of Knowledge'' achievement. #Completing the ''The Vault'' achievement. #Completing the ''One of a kind'' achievement. #*Gives two '''High Grade Crates'''.
